title: Great location Getaway with Rooftop Deck & Grill
description:
3 Kings Nashville

The space
Perfectly perched amidst all of Music City's charm discover 3 Kings Nashville! Named after its three king-sized beds, this modern abode offers the perfect landing pad for a large family or friend getaway. Comfort flows throughout the home's open-concept layout, four en-suite bedrooms, and fabulous rooftop deck. Lined by twinkle lights and highlighted by radiant sunrise and sunset views, the huge rooftop deck features alfresco dining, putt-putt golf, a fire table, a gas grill, and the perfect wall for selfie-taking.

Inside, the colorful living room is adorned with plush furnishings, a large smart TV, and musical mementos. Spend evenings in streaming your favorite shows or dancing to tasteful tunes on the vinyl record player. Culinary enthusiasts will adore the full kitchen with its gleaming countertops, stainless steel appliances, and sizable breakfast bar. Additional interior amenities include central air-conditioning, a private washer/dryer, board games, and internet access. 

Downtown and Broadway's many entertainment venues, restaurants, and shops are a quick drive away. Some popular hotspots include The Parthenon, Ryman Auditorium, Centennial Park, the Country Music Hall of Fame and Museum, the Nashville Zoo at Grassmere, and the Johnny Cash Museum.

Guest access
As our guest, you'll have full access to the entire property, except for a few areas reserved for house supplies.
